beats.title: pictures over music, a lesson drags on

beats.text: psst! Faker!
What? *lifts his head up*
You almost fell asleep again
I know
Someone woke up at the wrong side of the bed this morning
You really like it when I'm in a bad mood, don't you?
Nah, I love it
*sigh* Shut up, Shad
Man, what's bugging you?!
Life
Alright, tell me what's wrong
Since when did you care?
Team Captain always gotta check on his team, so tell me! What's up?
It's the game...
What about it?
Hedgehogs! Stop talking and listen!
*whispers* The game is on the same day as my 1st anniversary with Amy
*whispers* Congrats
*whispers* Thanks but the thing is, our special date is on that day too. We've been planning for the day to come
*whispers* Can't you just have your date on a different day?
*whispers* It's not possible, the restaurant Amy really likes is only available on our Anniversary
*whispers* Is there any other restaurants you guys can go to?
*whispers* No, they're all closed this week...
*whispers* Why can't you just cancel the date and have it some time later after graduation
*whispers* I'm not sure if Amy wants to have the date that late..
*whispers* Then ask her if it's alright to have the date another day
*stands out of his seat* Look, I know this date means a lot to you two, but we have a game coming up. So choose wisely.
*sigh* *walks out the classroom*
Yo! Sonic my man! How about that punch in the face you deserve?
Knock it off, Knucklehead
Who says you can tell me what to do?
I'm the Team Captain, I can tell you what to do
Trust me, he'll kick you out the team if you don't obey his orders
Alright, sheesh.
and I'll kick you out if you don't make a choice, faker
What choice? What's going on here?
Apparently, the game is on the same day of Sonic's and Amy's 'special' date
IT'S SPECIAL TO US!
SO THE GAME'S NOT SPECIAL?!
IT IS SPECIAL! BUT SO IS AMY! I CAN'T JUST BLANK HER!
AMY HAD A LOT OF ATTENTION FROM YOU FOR ALMOST A YEAR! CAN'T YOU JUST DO SOMETHING ELSE THAT YOU WANT TO DO THAT DOESN'T INVOLVE HER?
WHOA! WHOA! What's going on here?!
I have no clue they're just arguing about the game and Amy
Guys, can't you just-
WHAT IF YOU AND ROUGE HAD A SPECIAL DATE ON THAT DAY?! WHAT WOULD YOU DO?
HEY! ROUGE'S NOT INVOLVED IN THIS!
Oh for god sakes *walking towards them*
TAILS!
I don't know what's going on right now but you two need to shut the f**k up and be mature for once
...Yes, Tails
Good *lets go of their ears* Now explain to us without arguing about this situation going on here
Wow and you don't threaten him when he tells you what to do
SHUT UP, KNUCKS! *hits him with baseball bat*
OW! WHAT THE HELL, MAN?
YOU CAN'T HIT A GUY WITH GLASSES!
YOU'RE NOT EVEN WEARING ANY!
I WEAR THEM SOMETIMES!
WOULD YOU TWO SHUT UP SO WE CAN EXPLAIN?!
